description:
Create a CNC-ready 2D drawing of a cabinet side panel based on the specifications in '/home/ga/Documents/cabinet_spec.txt'. 

1. Open the spec file to read dimensions.
2. In LibreCAD, create three layers: 'PANEL' (White/7), 'DRILLING' (Red/1), and 'DADO' (Cyan/4).
3. Draw the panel outline on the 'PANEL' layer, including the specified Toe Kick notch.
4. Draw the back groove on the 'DADO' layer according to the specs.
5. Create the shelf pin hole array on the 'DRILLING' layer using the 'System 32' parameters (32mm vertical spacing).
6. Save the file to '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/side_panel_cnc.dxf'.
